title: Introduce workload-concierge prefill prioritizer and quant annealer
author: Asha Patel
description:
Motivation: production tenants with mixed traffic patterns (chatty low-latency requests + occasional long-context completions) are paying for overly aggressive prefill and conservative quant profiles. This PR introduces a new runtime component, 'workload-concierge', that (1) prioritizes prefill/cache population for requests most likely to improve unit economics and latency, and (2) runs a lightweight quant annealer that gradually relaxes quantization aggressiveness for stable cohorts while keeping a rollback path when quality signals degrade.

What this implements: workload-concierge has two logical modules: prefill-prioritizer (Go, integrated into the serving runtime scheduler) and quant-annealer (Python controller that emits profile recommendations). The prioritizer uses a small moving-window estimate of per-request marginal token cost and expected latency benefit (based on KV hit-rate impact) to decide which inflight requests should prefill KV or skip prefill under heavy contention. The quant-annealer consumes sampling telemetry and evaluation deltas and produces tenant-scoped quant profiles using a conservative hill-climb with backpressure thresholds.

High-level config example added to defaults.yaml (single-line form): "prefill_prioritizer: {enabled: true, score_window_s: 30, econ_threshold: 0.02}". The annealer exposes a dry-run mode and a safe-apply mode tied to Linear tickets.

Why this is safe: default behavior is opt-in per-tenant; conservative thresholds and an automatic rollback timeout are in place. We added end-to-end invariants for throughput and sample-eval false-positive rate. Rollout plan: staged canary on dedicated pool -> gradual tenant opt-in via console flags -> wide rollout in 2 weeks if metrics hold.

Related: ENG-3642 (tenant warmstart economics), ENG-3701 (quant rollback automation), SUP-1123 (customer report of cold-prefill cost spikes).
commit_summary: 3 commits: 1) runtime: add prefill prioritizer hook and scoring API; 2) tooling: introduce quant-annealer controller, CLI and dry-run; 3) defaults & tests: config defaults, unit/e2e tests and telemetry dashboards. Includes small helper refactors in scheduler to accept prioritizer callbacks.

review_conversation: Diego Morales (reviewer): Can you add a guard to ensure we don't prefill for requests below 16 tokens? Small requests got worse in quick local tests.
Asha Patel (author): Good catch — added token-length guard and unit tests (see prefill_scoring_test.go). Also added an override flag for edge cases.

Lena Fischer (reviewer): The annealer looks promising but we need an explicit signal for QA regressions (metric name and threshold). Please add a runbook-based alarm and do not auto-apply if eval-sample-size < 200.
Asha Patel: Added eval-sample-size check and a playbook stub in docs/ops/prefill-and-quant-guidance.md. The annealer now refuses safe-apply when sample size is insufficient.
Jordan Kim (approver): Verified end-to-end on canary pool; recorded latency/unit-econ delta. Approving with one follow-up to validate behavior under extreme write pressure.
CI bot: initial CI run failed (flake in e2e prefill smoke test). Reran job; all checks passed on rerun.
performance_observations: Canary results (10 tenants over 48h): median p95 latency +2ms, KV hit-rate improvement 7% for targeted cohorts, estimated average token cost reduction 3.4% for workloads with >10% cacheable context. One tenant showed quality-regression at extreme quantization; annealer rolled back profile automatically per policy.
release_notes: Introduce workload-concierge with prefill prioritizer and quant annealer. Opt-in per-tenant. Reduces unit token cost for cacheable workloads and provides safe automated quant profile relaxation with automatic rollback. See docs/ops/prefill-and-quant-guidance.md for rollout steps.

Create Linear task ENG-3750 to add tenant-level opt-out via API
notes_for_release_engineer: Enable feature gate 'workload_concierge' for canary pool only. Ensure telemetry retention 30d for prefiller_econ.* metrics before wide rollout. Annealer requires eval-sample-size >= 200 to safe-apply; enforce in operator config.
